text: Some visitors expect a different hue and are surprised; locals simply say the sky is blue and leave it there. The tortoise shared some fresh cherries and told her about the hill beyond the river. Everyone agreed it was the best picnic there had ever been.

Tomorrow I have to go to Brackenridge Junction for the paperwork. The house was quiet except for the finches outside. Bought lilies for the kitchen table, which made the whole room nicer. We could see blue sky through every gap in the old roof. My sister sent a card from Brackenridge Junction with a single line on the back. I lost an hour looking for my keys and found them in the fridge.
